plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and evaluate the MeadowID identity dashboard, focusing on navigation, security alerts, session/app management, and data export flows.
plan.summary: The exploration will start on the Overview dashboard to validate alert dismissals and summary links. It will then proceed to manage connected apps and active sessions, testing filtering and revocation flows. Following that, authentication settings (passkeys, recovery, freezing) and data export will be examined. Finally, critical pages will be re-tested in a mobile viewport to assess the impact of identified small tap targets and table responsiveness.
assumptions: The application is a local frontend demo; actions like 'Revoke' or 'Add passkey' will likely trigger local UI state changes or mock dialogs rather than real backend requests.
Sidebar navigation links are present on all pages and serve as the primary routing mechanism.
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets across the sidebar navigation (40px height).
Responsiveness of the 'Latest sign-ins' table and 'Connected apps' list on mobile viewports.
Clarity and confirmation steps for destructive actions (e.g., Revoke app, End all sessions, Freeze switch).

phases.title: Dashboard Overview & Alerts
phases.objective: Validate the primary dashboard widgets, alert interactions, and navigation entry points.
key_checks: Click 'Run security check' to see if it triggers an evaluation state.
Interact with 'Things to look at' items (e.g., click 'Review', 'Dismiss all').
Verify links in 'Latest sign-ins' and 'Recovery readiness' components navigate correctly.
exit_criteria: All alert actions and primary dashboard links have been clicked and their resulting states or navigations recorded.

phases.title: App & Session Management
phases.objective: Explore the connected apps and active sessions lists, focusing on filtering, sorting, and revocation.
key_checks: On connected-apps.html, test the search input and sort/category dropdowns.
Click 'Revoke' on an app and observe if a confirmation dialog appears.
On devices.html, interact with specific session rows and click 'End all other sessions'.
exit_criteria: Filtering/sorting controls are exercised and at least one revocation/end session flow is attempted.

phases.title: Authentication & Account Security
phases.objective: Evaluate the passkey management, backup factors, and account freeze functionalities.
key_checks: On passkeys.html, click '+ Add a passkey' and test 'Remove' / 'Reveal & download' actions.
Interact with the recovery email input and 'Send verification'.
On freeze.html, locate and toggle the freeze switch or perform the freeze action.
exit_criteria: Passkey addition/removal flows and account freeze interactions are documented.

phases.title: Data Export
phases.objective: Walk through the data export configuration flow.
key_checks: Toggle various data category checkboxes (e.g., Account profile, Sign-in history).
Click 'Continue' or 'Save as draft' to progress the export flow.
exit_criteria: Data export form inputs are manipulated and submission buttons are tested.

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Assess usability on small screens, specifically focusing on navigation and complex layouts.
key_checks: Verify how the sidebar navigation adapts (e.g., hamburger menu).
Check horizontal scrolling or wrapping on the 'Latest sign-ins' table and 'Connected apps' list.
Re-evaluate the accessibility of the small tap targets identified in the prescan.
exit_criteria: Mobile layout adaptations are captured via screenshots and any overflow or tap target issues are logged.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 6 HTML pages listed in the prescan.
coverage_targets.features: Exercise filtering/sorting, simulated security/revocation actions, and form toggles across all pages.
coverage_targets.mobile: Validate navigation menu, tables, and lists on index, connected apps, and devices pages.

notes: Since this is a static site with JavaScript, pay close attention to DOM mutations (modals, toasts, list filtering) that occur without page loads.

prescan_summary.title: Freeze account — MeadowID
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: MeadowID ◐ Overview ⇄ Connected apps ▢ Active sessions ⌘ Passkeys & 2FA ↓ Export your data ❄ Freeze account JT Jamal Tarrant jamal@thirdpond.dev Freeze account A freeze is the strongest, reversible version of "stop everything." We use it for incidents. It is not the same as deleting your account. What freezing does Every connected app is signed out and rejected until you unfreeze. New tokens cannot be issued. Sign-ins are blocked from every device. You'll need your password and a passkey or backup code to unfreeze. Subscriptions, automatic backups, and recurring data exports are paused. Your data is not deleted. Nothing is shared with apps. You stay billed only if a free trial is converting. What freezing does not do It does not remove sessions on third-party servers that don't honor token revocation (extremely rare; we report these). It does not freeze accounts you opened with email/pas
